title: heptapleurum verticillatum
intro: Heptapleurum verticillatum, commonly known as Schisandra, is a type of vine native to the mountainous regions of Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include improving liver function, boosting immunity, and enhancing cognitive function. The therapeutic actions of Schisandra include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and adaptogenic properties, which help to protect the body from oxidative stress and promote balance in the body's physiological processes. The bioactive constituents of Schisandra include schisandrins, schisantherin A, and gomisin A, which have been identified as responsible for its medicinal properties.
